preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the binary strings S and P must be between 3 and 1000.
The lengths of S and P must be equal to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any('1' in S and '0' in S for S in test_cases) and any('1' in P and '0' in P for P in test_cases)
postconditions.description: If both S and P contain at least one '1' and one '0', it is possible to convert S to P.

postconditions.expression: all('1' in S or '0' in S for S in test_cases) and all('1' in P or '0' in P for P in test_cases)
postconditions.description: If either S or P contains only '1's or only '0's, it is not possible to convert S to P.
